articles.title: Hace un mes nadie se lo habría creído
articles.body: Había cierto temor en Can Barça antes de iniciarse la temporada por el poder ofensivo que iba a ofrecer en esta temporada. No en vano, habían dejado el equipo tres jugadores claves en este aspecto como eran Lewandowski, Ferran y Rashford. Entre los tres habían anotado 54 goles en el pasado ejercicio. Para igualarlos los delanteros azulgrana tendrían que espabilar. Cuando llevamos cuatro jornadas de Liga ya nadie se acuerda de esos tres. El Barça vive de goleada en goleada y ya está en los más alto de la clasificación y en solitario. El Barça tiene una media goleadora de más de cuatro tantos por partido. Y lo curioso del tema es que los sustitutos no han sido los artífices de los goles. El tridente ofensivo del Barcelona lo forman Raphinha, Lamine Yamal y Fermín. Son una máquina de hacer goles. En Mestalla estos tres se dieron un festival y abrieron la lata en perfecta combinación. Y pudieron ser más porque el Barça fue un vendaval ofensivo y pudo marcar muchos más. Dimitrievski, el mejor del rival. Lo dicho si se lo cuentan hace un mes, nadie se lo cree. Anthony Gordon ha llegado sin hacer mucho ruido. Ha sido el fichaje silencioso que ha ido entrando en el equipo poco a poco. Todavía no ha marcado ninguno, pero con la de Mestalla ha dado cuatro asistencias a su compañero. Y pudieron ser más porque dio otro balón de gol a Lamine, pero su remate lo sacó Dimitrievski. El británico ha entrado con muy buen pie en el equipo Muy mala suerte la de Eric García en Valencia. El hecho de tener que retirarse lesionado siempre es duro para un jugador. Pero si el golpe te lo da un compañero en vez de un rival es mucho más duro. Es lo que sucedió en un córner cuando Rodri hizo un giro inesperado y le dio un cabezazo a Eric García que tuvo que irse. Joan García ya empieza a hacer de las suyas. Si el poder ofensivo del Barcelona es brutal, cerrar la portería también es clave para conseguir los éxitos. En Mestalla, otra vez la portería a cero. El Barcelona lo ha conseguido en tres de los cuatro partidos disputados. Clave para ser el líder. En la primera parte le sacó dos a Danjuma que podrían haber cambiado el partido. Aunque para pulpo: Dimitrievski. SI no es por él al Valencia la cae un carro. Rodri salió por primera vez de titular. Y confirmó lo que todos sabían, que es un jugador que va a dar muchísimo al Barcelona. Fue un espectáculo. Es el director de juego azulgrana, pero cuando hace falta es un central más que ayuda dentro del área; o roba el balón clave que luego se convierte en el tercer gol; o juega de extremo y llega a la línea de fondo para dar un pase. Un futbolista total. Gabriel Jesus debutó con el Barcelona. Flick le dio diez minutos y entró en lugar de Pedri. Y se colocó como delantero centro. Raphinha cambió de posición y se fue a la media punta. Se le vio con ganas y tuvo una ocasión para marcar.

articles.title: Hansi Flick talks Lamine Yamal, Fermin Lopez and Rodri after Barcelona hammer Valencia
articles.summary: The Catalans remain perfect in La Liga.
articles.body:
Hansi Flick was a happy man after seeing his Barcelona team continue their perfect start to the new La Liga season with a 5-0 thrashing of Valencia at Mestalla .

The Catalans giants put in another impressive showing, with Lamine Yamal, Fermin Lopez and Rodri all shining. Flick was happy to talk about all three after the game.

"Fermín we can already see the type of player he is. He brings energy, goals, is good with the ball, presses… I like more control sometimes, but he's a young player. His intensity is very high. He's doing very well," he told reporters. "Everything Rodri has done makes sense. He is very good with the ball and without the ball. And I don't forget that Bernal is doing a great job. If it continues like this, it will be a great opportunity to improve more and more. Rodri is an absolute leader, what he does on the pitch and off is incredible."

If it continues like this, it will be a great opportunity to improve more and more. Rodri is an absolute leader, what he does on the pitch and off is incredible."

Flick also spoke about why Yamal played the whole game despite missing training on Saturday due to a knock.

"This morning I spoke with Lamine, he told me he was fine. He's always switched on with the pressure in the match, it's good," he explained. "We have many players who can start. I have to manage the situations and try to keep everyone happy. I'm happy with Olmo and I feel like he wants more. We always try to make the best decisions for the team."

Barcelona now switch focus to the Champions League and a midweek game against Feyenoord.

articles.title: Cruzeiro and Athletico announce line-ups for 26th-round clash
articles.summary: Cruzeiro and Athletico have announced their lineups for this Sunday’s clash (6), at 4pm, at Mineirão, in the 26th round of the Brasileirão.Globo (for PR and...
articles.body:
Cruzeiro and Athletico have announced their lineups for this Sunday's clash (6), at 4pm, at Mineirão, in the 26th round of the Brasileirão.

Globo (for PR and MG) and Premiere will broadcast the match. And you can follow the main live updates in the card below:

The teams are battling near the top of the table. Cruzeiro are sixth with 39 points, while Athletico are third with 45.

Center-back Jonathan Jesus is the latest name on the injury list. Bruno Rodrigues, Gabriel Pec and Sinisterra are still recovering.

On the other hand, center-back Fabrício Bruno returns after serving a suspension in the last Brasileirão match, against Vasco.

Midfielder Gerson was a doubt after playing through pain in the defeat to Atlético-MG in midweek, in the Copa do Brasil. He has recovered and will start.

Artur Jorge makes THREE changes from the match against Atlético-MG:

João Marcelo, Rojas and Matheus Henrique come in; Jonathan Jesus, Villalba and Wesley drop out.

Otávio; Fagner, Fabrício Bruno, João Marcelo and Rojas; Lucas Romero, Gerson, Matheus Henrique and Matheus Pereira; Arroyo and Kaio Jorge.

Head coach Odair Hellmann has TWO absences. Right-back Benavídez is suspended. And left-back Claudinho is injured.

Gilberto Moraes (formerly of Bahia) comes in at right-back. On the other hand, Lucas Esquivel is available again — he starts on the bench.

The big news is in goal. After his mistakes in the 3-3 draw with Fluminense, Santos goes to the BENCH. Mycael gets a chance.

Mycael; Dantas, Aguirre and Arthur Dias; Gilberto Moraes, Luiz Gustavo, Jadson, João Cruz and Mendoza; Leozinho and Kevin Viveros.

articles.title: Arsenal claim derby honours v Chelsea, Everton level late v Man Utd
articles.summary: Arsenal needed to come from behind to win a breathless game 2-1 against Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium as Kai Havertz scored for the third time in the Premi...
articles.body:
Arsenal needed to come from behind to win a breathless game 2-1 against Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium as Kai Havertz scored for the third time in the Premier League against his former club.

Havertz netted midway through the first half to equalise after Morgan Rogers, who the champions missed out on signing during the transfer window, had stunned home fans with a volleyed goal after 77 seconds.

The Germany international was instrumental too in Martin Odegaard's 50th-minute winner, executing a delightful dummy to leave Chelsea's defence flatfooted and create room for the captain to rifle home.

Chelsea had lost four league games in a row at the Emirates, conceding 11 goals, but here they gave Arsenal a far sterner examination than at any time during that sequence, with the front three of Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro and Rogers again showing their potential as assets in a possible title challenge.

Yet Xabi Alonso appeared no closer to solving the enigma of a team so irresistible in attack yet too easily pulled into all the wrong shapes defensively and in midfield.

In truth, Arsenal's play and Chelsea's wobbles ought to have brought victory by a larger margin, Emiliano Martinez with a wonderful stop to deny Bukayo Saka, before David Raya gave a reminder of his own indispensability with an even better save to keep out Estevao.

Earlier, Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a dream stoppage-time equaliser on his Everton debut to earn a 2-2 draw against Manchester United and lift the mood at the end of a difficult week.

Deadline day ended in disappointment for fans of both clubs but the Toffees' inaction was particularly concerning given Tuesday's botched business left them with a threadbare squad and an unhappy manager.

David Moyes admitted he had "to live with disappointments" and called for Everton players to "muck in", but Sunday looked set to end in further frustration after substitute Benjamin Sesko's 88th-minute header put United on course for a late victory.

Tyrique George's thunderous strike had cancelled out a fine Bryan Mbeumo effort moments earlier but the Slovenia international would not prove United's match-winning substitute for the second time at Hill Dickinson Stadium this year.

Instead, deadline-day acquisition Maitland-Niles came off the bench to rifle home from distance to snatch a dramatic late point and spark bedlam.

articles.title: Lewis, O’Reilly And Foden To Start | 4-2-3-1 Manchester City Predicted Lineup vs Porto
articles.summary: Manchester City will clash heads with Porto at the Estadio do Dragao this Tuesday night as they look to secure a win in the UEFA Champions League. The Mancun...
articles.body:
Manchester City will clash heads with Porto at the Estadio do Dragao this Tuesday night as they look to secure a win in the UEFA Champions League. The Mancunian giants managed to secure a narrow 1-0 win over Coventry City recently, which should keep them in good spirits going into this game.

Enzo Maresca will opt for the 4-2-3-1 formation and is expected to make a few changes to his first team for this clash. Rico Lewis, Nico O'Reilly and Phil Foden could all play from the start of this game.

4-2-3-1 Manchester City Predicted Lineup To Face Porto

Gianluigi Donnarumma will operate in between the sticks for Man City after keeping a clean sheet in his last outing. Ruben Dias will continue to function alongside Marc Guehi at the centre of Maresca's defence as they look to keep a good shape on the defensive end of the field.

Rico Lewis will fill in as the right-back, while Josko Gvardiol hopes to prove his worth on the other side as the left-back. Both of them will get the freedom to go forward and express themselves inside the opponent's half.

Abdukodir Khusanov will offer cover for the defensive positions on the bench.

MANCHESTER, ENGLAND – SEPTEMBER 05: Antoine Semenyo of Manchester City during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Manchester City and Coventry City at Etihad Stadium on September 05, 2026 in Manchester, England. (Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images)

Nico O'Reilly and Elliot Anderson will anchor the midfield for Man City as they try to win the 50-50 battles at the centre of the park and engineer some decent chances in the final third.

The gifted trio of Phil Foden, Rayan Cherki and Antoine Semenyo will operate just ahead of them as part of the Man City attack. All three of them need to be at their best if the Mancunian club are to secure a victory at the Estadio do Dragao in midweek.

Iliman Ndiaye and Enzo Fernandez will be available for selection on the bench and might come on to influence the game in the second half if required.

Erling Haaland will spearhead Man City 's attack up top. He managed to score the winning goal against Coventry City, which should give him a ton of confidence ahead of this game.

Ryan McAiddo will have to settle for a spot on the bench as he waits for his chance to make an impact in the latter stages of the game if needed.
